meta.name: The Night Manager
meta.description: A hotel's night manager is the only weapon against a dangerous arms dealer. Will he be able to stop him?

videos.title: Part I - Zakhm
videos.overview: Shaan Sengupta, the night manager of Dhaka's Hotel Orient Pearl, gets embroiled in the arms-dealing world of billionaire Shelly Rungta for going beyond duty for a special guest.

videos.title: Part I - Mission
videos.overview: Unable to recover from the incidents in Dhaka, Shaan agrees to a significant change that would have a domino effect on his and Shelly’s lives.

videos.title: Part I - Mehmaan
videos.overview: Shaan utilises his time in Shelly’s villa by befriending his son. Meanwhile, Lipika keeps a close eye on Shaan and makes moves of her own.

videos.title: Part I - Sweetly-waala
videos.overview: Disruptions in Shelly’s perfect world pave the way for Shaan, but Lipika's troubles only seem to be beginning.

videos.title: Part II - Abhimanyu
videos.overview: Shaan faces a crucial test, and Lipika's shocking discovery could change the course of her mission. As BJ creates trouble, where is GV?

videos.title: Part II - Magic Trick
videos.overview: Shaan executes a risky plan to avoid Shelly’s suspicions. Meanwhile, Lipika, Danish and their team fend off an attempt to bury their mission.

videos.title: Part II - Imarti
videos.overview: Shaan comes face to face with his past as he and Lipika get one last chance to take down Shelly's empire.
